words.definition: a. 听得见的; [电] 可闻的
words.definition_en: heard or perceptible by the ear

examples.en: Her voice was barely audible over the traffic.
examples.zh: 车流声中，她的声音几乎听不见。

examples.en: He gave an audible sigh of relief.
examples.zh: 他发出一声听得见的宽慰叹息。

examples.en: The music was audible from the street.
examples.zh: 从街上就能听见那音乐。

contexts.sentence: The alarm was barely audible from the kitchen.

words.definition: n. 剧本, 剧本集
words.definition_en: a notebook containing descriptions and diagrams of the plays that a team has practiced (especially an American football team) · a book containing the scripts of one or more dramatic plays

examples.en: The team followed the coach's playbook exactly.
examples.zh: 球队完全照着教练的战术手册打。

examples.en: That trick is straight out of the startup playbook.
examples.zh: 那一招完全是创业公司的老套路。

examples.en: We need a new playbook for this market.
examples.zh: 这个市场我们需要一套新打法。

words.definition: n. 减轻, 解除, 救济, 安慰, 调剂, 浮雕, 换班, (地势的)起伏; [医] 缓减, 减轻, 浮雕(绘画中)
words.definition_en: the feeling that comes when something burdensome is removed or reduced · the condition of being comfortable or relieved (especially after being relieved of distress)

examples.en: What a relief to finally finish the exam!
examples.zh: 终于考完试了，真是如释重负！

examples.en: They sent food and medicine for disaster relief.
examples.zh: 他们送去了食品和药品用于救灾。

examples.en: The medicine gave her quick relief from the headache.
examples.zh: 这种药很快缓解了她的头痛。

words.definition: a. 可察觉的, 能感觉得到的, 看得见的
words.definition_en: capable of being perceived by the mind or senses · easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind

examples.en: There was a perceptible change in her mood.
examples.zh: 她的情绪有了明显的变化。

examples.en: The difference is barely perceptible to the eye.
examples.zh: 这种差异肉眼几乎察觉不到。

examples.en: His voice was barely perceptible above the noise.
examples.zh: 他的声音在嘈杂中几乎听不见。

words.definition: a. 累赘的, 恼人的, 繁重的; [法] 难于负担的, 压抑的, 累赘的
words.definition_en: not easily borne; wearing; I only had to greet the guests"

examples.en: The heavy backpack became burdensome during the long hike.
examples.zh: 沉重的背包在长途徒步中变得累赘。

examples.en: She found the paperwork too burdensome to finish alone.
examples.zh: 她发现这些文书工作太繁重，一个人完成不了。

examples.en: The new regulations place a burdensome load on small businesses.
examples.zh: 新法规给小企业带来了沉重的负担。

words.definition: vt. 抚慰, 平息, 使和解, 怀柔
words.definition_en: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of

examples.en: She placated the crying baby with a toy.
examples.zh: 她用一个玩具抚慰了哭闹的婴儿。

examples.en: The manager tried to placate angry customers.
examples.zh: 经理试图安抚愤怒的顾客。

examples.en: He placated his boss by finishing the report early.
examples.zh: 他提前完成报告，以此安抚老板。

contexts.sentence: He tried to placate the irate customer at the counter.

words.definition: a. 发怒的, 生气的
words.definition_en: feeling or showing extreme anger

examples.en: The irate customer demanded a refund.
examples.zh: 愤怒的顾客要求退款。

examples.en: She received an irate email from her boss.
examples.zh: 她收到老板一封怒气冲冲的邮件。

examples.en: The irate driver honked his horn loudly.
examples.zh: 愤怒的司机大声按喇叭。

contexts.sentence: He tried to placate the irate customer at the counter.

words.definition: n. 角, 角质, 喇叭, 号角; a. 角制的; vt. 用角触, 长角于
words.definition_en: a noisemaker (as at parties or games) that makes a loud noise when you blow through it · one of the bony outgrowths on the heads of certain ungulates

examples.en: The bull has a sharp horn.
examples.zh: 公牛有一只尖角。

examples.en: He honked the horn to warn others.
examples.zh: 他按喇叭警告其他人。

examples.en: The goat horned the fence.
examples.zh: 山羊用角顶了栅栏。

words.definition: n. 雁鸣, 汽车的喇叭声; vi. 雁鸣叫, 按汽车喇叭; vt. 揿(喇叭)
words.definition_en: the cry of a goose (or any sound resembling this)

examples.en: The goose honked loudly in the morning.
examples.zh: 那只鹅在清晨大声鸣叫。

examples.en: He honked the horn to warn the pedestrian.
examples.zh: 他按响喇叭提醒行人。

examples.en: The car honked twice before the light turned green.
examples.zh: 绿灯亮前，汽车鸣了两声喇叭。

words.definition: n. 自然的发展, 结果, 副产物, 分枝; [医] 赘疣
words.definition_en: a natural consequence of development

examples.en: Her success is an outgrowth of hard work.
examples.zh: 她的成功是努力工作的自然结果。

examples.en: The new policy was an outgrowth of public demand.
examples.zh: 新政策是公众需求的产物。

examples.en: The tumor is an abnormal outgrowth on the skin.
examples.zh: 这个肿瘤是皮肤上的异常赘生物。

words.definition: n. 结果, 重要性; [法] 结果, 后果, 推断
words.definition_en: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon · the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual

examples.en: As a consequence, we missed the train.
examples.zh: 结果，我们错过了火车。

examples.en: He faced the consequences of his actions.
examples.zh: 他承担了自己行为的后果。

examples.en: This is a matter of great consequence.
examples.zh: 这是一件非常重要的事情。

words.definition: n. 肿大, 肿块, 瘤, 赘生物, 肿瘤; [医] 瘤; 肿胀, 肿块
words.definition_en: an abnormal new mass of tissue that serves no purpose

examples.en: The tumor was benign, so the patient was relieved.
examples.zh: 肿瘤是良性的，所以病人松了一口气。

examples.en: He found a small tumor on his arm.
examples.zh: 他胳膊上发现了一个小肿块。

examples.en: Doctors removed the tumor successfully.
examples.zh: 医生成功切除了肿瘤。

words.definition: a. 反常的, 不规则的, 变态的, 畸形的; n. 畸形的人
words.definition_en: not normal; not typical or usual or regular or conforming to a norm · departing from the normal in e.g. intelligence and development

examples.en: The weather is abnormal for this season.
examples.zh: 这种天气在这个季节很不正常。

examples.en: His abnormal behavior worried his parents.
examples.zh: 他反常的行为让父母担心。

examples.en: The test showed abnormal cells in her body.
examples.zh: 检查显示她体内有异常细胞。

words.definition: n. 鹅, 雌鹅, 鹅肉, 弯把熨斗; vt. 与...性交, 突然加大油门, 使生色, 喝倒彩
words.definition_en: web-footed long-necked typically gregarious migratory aquatic birds usually larger and less aquatic than ducks · flesh of a goose (domestic or wild)

examples.en: A goose is swimming in the lake.
examples.zh: 一只鹅在湖里游泳。

examples.en: I got goose bumps when I heard the scary story.
examples.zh: 听到恐怖故事我起鸡皮疙瘩。

examples.en: The goose chased the children in the park.
examples.zh: 鹅在公园里追孩子们。

words.definition: n. 熊; vt. 忍受, 支承, 产生, 怀有, 通过卖空使跌价; vi. 忍受, 结果实, 压挤, 行进, 转向
words.definition_en: massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws · an investor with a pessimistic market outlook; an investor who expects prices to fall and so sells now in order to buy later at a lower price

examples.en: The bear is fishing in the river.
examples.zh: 那只熊正在河里捕鱼。

examples.en: I can't bear the noise anymore.
examples.zh: 我再也忍受不了这噪音了。

examples.en: This tree bears many apples every year.
examples.zh: 这棵树每年结很多苹果。

words.definition: a. 食肉的; [医] 食肉的
words.definition_en: relating to or characteristic of carnivores · (used of plants as well as animals) feeding on animals

examples.en: Lions are carnivorous animals that hunt for meat.
examples.zh: 狮子是食肉动物，以捕猎为生。

examples.en: The carnivorous plant traps insects with its leaves.
examples.zh: 这种食肉植物用叶子捕捉昆虫。

examples.en: My dog is carnivorous and loves eating beef.
examples.zh: 我的狗是食肉动物，喜欢吃牛肉。

words.definition: a. 无所不吃的, 杂食的, 什么都喜欢的
words.definition_en: feeding on both plants and animals

examples.en: Raccoons are omnivorous and eat almost anything.
examples.zh: 浣熊是杂食动物，几乎什么都吃。

examples.en: She has an omnivorous appetite for books and movies.
examples.zh: 她对书籍和电影有着广泛的兴趣。

examples.en: As an omnivorous reader, he enjoys both novels and science.
examples.zh: 作为一位博览群书的读者，他既喜欢小说也喜欢科学。

words.definition: n. 哺乳动物; [化] 哺乳动物
words.definition_en: any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk

examples.en: A whale is a mammal, not a fish.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼是哺乳动物，不是鱼。

examples.en: Humans are mammals, too.
examples.zh: 人类也是哺乳动物。

examples.en: This mammal lives in the ocean.
examples.zh: 这种哺乳动物生活在海洋里。

words.definition: a. 毛发蓬乱的, 粗浓的, 草木丛生的
words.definition_en: used of hair; thick and poorly groomed · having a very rough nap or covered with hanging shags

examples.en: The shaggy dog shook water everywhere.
examples.zh: 那只毛茸茸的狗甩得到处是水。

examples.en: My shaggy hair needs a comb.
examples.zh: 我蓬乱的头发需要梳一梳。

examples.en: We walked through shaggy grass.
examples.zh: 我们穿过杂草丛生的草地。

words.definition: n. 脊椎动物; a. 有椎骨的, 有脊椎的
words.definition_en: animals having a bony or cartilaginous skeleton with a segmented spinal column and a large brain enclosed in a skull or cranium

examples.en: Humans are vertebrates.
examples.zh: 人类是脊椎动物。

examples.en: A vertebrate animal has a backbone.
examples.zh: 脊椎动物有脊骨。

examples.en: Fish are the oldest vertebrates.
examples.zh: 鱼是最古老的脊椎动物。

words.definition: n. 浣熊, 浣熊毛皮
words.definition_en: the fur of the North American racoon · an omnivorous nocturnal mammal native to North America and Central America

examples.en: A raccoon stole my sandwich last night.
examples.zh: 一只浣熊昨晚偷了我的三明治。

examples.en: She wore a coat made of raccoon fur.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件浣熊毛皮大衣。

examples.en: The raccoon rummaged through the trash can.
examples.zh: 浣熊在垃圾桶里翻找食物。

words.definition: n. 食欲, 欲望, 爱好; [医] 食欲
words.definition_en: a feeling of craving something

examples.en: I have no appetite for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我没胃口吃饭。

examples.en: He has an appetite for adventure.
examples.zh: 他对冒险有强烈的欲望。

examples.en: Her appetite for books is endless.
examples.zh: 她对书籍的爱好无止境。

words.definition: v. 仔细翻寻, 仔细搜查, 检查出; n. 仔细翻找, 查出的物件
words.definition_en: search haphazardly

examples.en: She rummaged through her bag for keys.
examples.zh: 她翻遍了包找钥匙。

examples.en: He rummaged around in the drawer.
examples.zh: 他在抽屉里到处翻找。

examples.en: After a quick rummage, she found the ticket.
examples.zh: 快速翻找后，她找到了票。

words.definition: a. 边缘的, 最低限度的, 有旁注的; [医] 缘的
words.definition_en: producing at a rate that barely covers production costs

examples.en: The marginal cost of production is very low.
examples.zh: 生产的边际成本非常低。

examples.en: There was only a marginal improvement in sales.
examples.zh: 销售额只有微小的改善。

examples.en: She wrote marginal notes in the textbook.
examples.zh: 她在课本上写了旁注。

words.definition: adv. 偶然地, 随意地；杂乱地
words.definition_en: in a random manner · without care; in a slapdash manner

examples.en: He threw his clothes haphazardly into the suitcase.
examples.zh: 他把衣服随手乱扔进行李箱。

examples.en: The books were arranged haphazardly on the shelf.
examples.zh: 书架上的书排列得杂乱无章。

examples.en: She haphazardly picked a restaurant for dinner.
examples.zh: 她随便挑了一家餐厅吃晚饭。

words.definition: 内阁；橱柜
words.definition_en: a piece of furniture resembling a cupboard with doors and shelves and drawers; for storage or display · persons appointed by a head of state to head executive departments of government and act as official advisers

examples.en: The cabinet approved the new policy.
examples.zh: 内阁批准了新政策。

examples.en: I keep my tea in the cabinet.
examples.zh: 我把茶叶放在橱柜里。

examples.en: She found the key in the file cabinet.
examples.zh: 她在文件柜里找到了钥匙。

words.definition: n. 看守者, 监护人, 保护人; a. 保护的
words.definition_en: a person who cares for persons or property

examples.en: My legal guardian signed the permission slip.
examples.zh: 我的法定监护人签署了许可单。

examples.en: The old lighthouse is a guardian for sailors.
examples.zh: 这座旧灯塔是水手的守护者。

examples.en: She prayed to her guardian angel.
examples.zh: 她向守护天使祈祷。

words.definition: n. 灯塔
words.definition_en: a tower with a light that gives warning of shoals to passing ships

examples.en: The lighthouse warns ships of the rocks.
examples.zh: 灯塔警示船只注意礁石。

examples.en: Her advice was a lighthouse in my confusion.
examples.zh: 她的建议是我迷茫时的灯塔。

examples.en: We climbed to the top of the lighthouse.
examples.zh: 我们爬到了灯塔顶部。

words.definition: n. 浅水, 浅滩, 沙洲, 鱼群, 暗礁, 潜在危险; a. 浅的; vi. 鱼成群而游, 变浅; vt. 使变浅
words.definition_en: a sandbank in a stretch of water that is visible at low tide · a stretch of shallow water

examples.en: A shoal of tiny fish swam near the shore.
examples.zh: 一大群小鱼在岸边游过。

examples.en: Our boat hit a shoal and stopped suddenly.
examples.zh: 我们的船撞上了沙洲，突然停了下来。

examples.en: The channel is full of shoals, so sail slowly.
examples.zh: 这条航道暗礁密布，所以要慢速航行。

words.definition: n. 捆, 束; vt. 包扎, 胡乱塞进; vi. 匆忙离开
words.definition_en: a package of several things tied together for carrying or storing

examples.en: She bought a bundle of flowers.
examples.zh: 她买了一束花。

examples.en: He bundled his clothes into a bag.
examples.zh: 他把衣服胡乱塞进包里。

examples.en: They bundled up and went out.
examples.zh: 他们裹得严严实实然后出门了。

words.definition: a. 善良的, 良性的; [医] 良性的
words.definition_en: not dangerous to health; not recurrent or progressive (especially of a tumor) · pleasant and beneficial in nature or influence

examples.en: She has a benign smile.
examples.zh: 她有着和善的微笑。

examples.en: The tumor is benign, so don't worry.
examples.zh: 肿瘤是良性的，所以别担心。

examples.en: The climate here is benign and mild.
examples.zh: 这里的气候温和宜人。

words.definition: a. 类人的
words.definition_en: an automaton that resembles a human being

examples.en: The humanoid robot waved at us.
examples.zh: 那个类人机器人向我们挥手。

examples.en: The statue had a humanoid form.
examples.zh: 那座雕像具有类人的形态。

examples.en: Some aliens are described as humanoid.
examples.zh: 有些外星人被描述为类人形。

words.definition: n. 获得, 获得物; [经] 收购, 招揽, 取得
words.definition_en: the act of contracting or assuming or acquiring possession of something · something acquired

examples.en: The company announced the acquisition of a small startup.
examples.zh: 公司宣布收购一家小型初创企业。

examples.en: Her latest acquisition is a rare painting.
examples.zh: 她最近获得的东西是一幅稀有画作。

examples.en: Language acquisition takes time and practice.
examples.zh: 语言习得需要时间和练习。

words.definition: n. 舰队, 港湾, 小河; a. 快速的, 敏捷的, 浅的, 短暂的; adv. 浅; vi. 疾驰, 飞逝, 掠过; vt. 消磨, 变换船(或船员)的位置
words.definition_en: group of aircraft operating together under the same ownership · group of motor vehicles operating together under the same ownership

examples.en: The fishing fleet is stuck in the harbor.
examples.zh: 渔船队被困在港口。

examples.en: The company has a fleet of rental cars.
examples.zh: 公司有一支租赁车队。

examples.en: The horse is fleet and strong.
examples.zh: 这匹马敏捷而强壮。

words.definition: n. 诉讼; [法] 诉讼, 诉讼案件
words.definition_en: a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy

examples.en: She filed a lawsuit against the company.
examples.zh: 她对那家公司提起了诉讼。

examples.en: The lawsuit cost them a lot of money.
examples.zh: 这场诉讼花了他们很多钱。

examples.en: He won the lawsuit and got compensation.
examples.zh: 他打赢了官司，获得了赔偿。

words.definition: n. 涡轮机; [化] 涡轮机
words.definition_en: rotary engine in which the kinetic energy of a moving fluid is converted into mechanical energy by causing a bladed rotor to rotate

examples.en: The wind turbine spins quickly on the hill.
examples.zh: 风车在山上快速旋转。

examples.en: Steam powers the turbine to generate electricity.
examples.zh: 蒸汽驱动涡轮机发电。

examples.en: A broken turbine caused the factory shutdown.
examples.zh: 一台涡轮机损坏导致工厂停工。

words.definition: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职; vi. 解散; [计] 解散
words.definition_en: bar from attention or consideration · cease to consider; put out of judicial consideration

examples.en: The teacher dismissed the class early.
examples.zh: 老师提前解散了班级。

examples.en: The boss dismissed him for being late.
examples.zh: 老板因为他迟到而开除他。

examples.en: She dismissed the idea as nonsense.
examples.zh: 她认为这个想法是胡说八道而不予理会。

words.definition: n. 电线, 电报, 电信, 铁丝网, 金属丝; vt. 用金属丝捆扎, 拍电报; vi. 打电报
words.definition_en: ligament made of metal and used to fasten things or make cages or fences etc · a metal conductor that carries electricity over a distance

examples.en: Don't touch that wire, it's dangerous.
examples.zh: 别碰那根电线，很危险。

examples.en: I'll wire you the money tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天把钱电汇给你。

examples.en: The fence is made of wire.
examples.zh: 这栅栏是铁丝做的。

words.definition: 网络安全；网络安保

examples.en: Cybersecurity is important for everyone.
examples.zh: 网络安全对每个人都很重要。

examples.en: She works in cybersecurity.
examples.zh: 她从事网络安全工作。

examples.en: Good cybersecurity protects your data.
examples.zh: 良好的网络安全保护你的数据。

words.definition: n. 宣言, 声明
words.definition_en: a public declaration of intentions (as issued by a political party or government)

examples.en: The party published its election manifesto yesterday.
examples.zh: 该党昨天发布了竞选宣言。

examples.en: She signed the environmental manifesto.
examples.zh: 她签署了环保宣言。

examples.en: His book reads like a personal manifesto.
examples.zh: 他的书读起来像一份个人宣言。

words.definition: vt. 安慰, 藉慰; n. 控制台; [计] 控制台
words.definition_en: a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system) · an ornamental scroll-shaped bracket (especially one used to support a wall fixture)

examples.en: She tried to console him after his loss.
examples.zh: 他失利后，她试图安慰他。

examples.en: He bought a new console for gaming.
examples.zh: 他买了一个新的游戏机。

examples.en: The console displays system information.
examples.zh: 控制台显示系统信息。

words.definition: a. 温和的, 温柔的, 淡味的, 适度的, 轻微的, (肥皂等)软性的; [医] 轻的, 缓和的
words.definition_en: moderate in type or degree or effect or force; far from extreme

examples.en: The weather is mild today.
examples.zh: 今天天气温和。

examples.en: I like mild cheese.
examples.zh: 我喜欢口味清淡的奶酪。

examples.en: He has a mild fever.
examples.zh: 他有点轻微发烧。

words.definition: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合; [化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚变
words.definition_en: an occurrence that involves the production of a union · the merging of adjacent sounds or syllables or words

examples.en: The dish is a fusion of Chinese and Italian cuisine.
examples.zh: 这道菜是中意烹饪的融合。

examples.en: The fusion of the metals requires high heat.
examples.zh: 金属的熔合需要高温。

examples.en: Nuclear fusion powers the sun.
examples.zh: 核聚变为太阳提供能量。

words.definition: n. 烹调风格, 烹调法, 烹饪, 厨房
words.definition_en: the practice or manner of preparing food or the food so prepared

examples.en: I love Italian cuisine, especially pasta.
examples.zh: 我爱意大利菜，尤其是意面。

examples.en: The restaurant serves authentic Sichuan cuisine.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅提供正宗的川菜。

examples.en: She studied French cuisine in Paris.
examples.zh: 她在巴黎学过法国烹饪。

words.definition: n. 意大利面食; [医] 糊剂, 泥膏剂
words.definition_en: a dish that contains pasta as its main ingredient · shaped and dried dough made from flour and water and sometimes egg

examples.en: I cooked pasta for dinner tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚煮了意大利面当晚餐。

examples.en: She prefers fresh pasta over dried.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢新鲜意大利面而非干面。

examples.en: This pasta sauce tastes really good.
examples.zh: 这种意大利面酱味道真好。

words.definition: a. 再发生的, 定期重复的, 循环的; [医] 复发的, 再发的, 回归的
words.definition_en: recurring again and again

examples.en: She had a recurrent dream about flying.
examples.zh: 她反复做飞翔的梦。

examples.en: The recurrent problem is lack of funding.
examples.zh: 反复出现的问题是资金短缺。

examples.en: His recurrent back pain bothers him a lot.
examples.zh: 他反复发作的背痛很困扰他。

words.definition: v. 规定, 保证
words.definition_en: specify as a condition or requirement in a contract or agreement; make an express demand or provision in an agreement · give a guarantee or promise of

examples.en: The contract stipulates that payment is due in 30 days.
examples.zh: 合同规定付款应在30天内完成。

examples.en: She stipulated for a flexible work schedule.
examples.zh: 她要求灵活的工作时间安排。

examples.en: The rules stipulate no phones in the meeting.
examples.zh: 规定要求会议中不得使用手机。

contexts.sentence: The contract stipulates a strict deadline for delivery.

words.definition: 转身；调整方向；改变策略
words.definition_en: the person in a rank around whom the others wheel and maneuver · axis consisting of a short shaft that supports something that turns

examples.en: He pivoted on his heel and left.
examples.zh: 他转身就走了。

examples.en: The company pivoted to online sales.
examples.zh: 公司转向了线上销售。

examples.en: She quickly pivoted to a new plan.
examples.zh: 她迅速调整到新计划。

contexts.sentence: The startup pivoted after burning through its runway.
contexts.meaning: 指公司转变了业务方向或策略

words.definition: 跑道；（比喻）可用资金或持续运营时间
words.definition_en: a chute down which logs can slide · a narrow platform extending from the stage into the audience in a theater or nightclub etc.

examples.en: The plane is waiting on the runway for takeoff.
examples.zh: 飞机在跑道上等待起飞。

examples.en: The model walked confidently down the runway.
examples.zh: 模特自信地走在T台上。

examples.en: We have enough runway to finish the project.
examples.zh: 我们有足够的时间完成这个项目。

contexts.sentence: The startup pivoted after burning through its runway.
contexts.meaning: 指公司能维持运营的资金或时间，本句中表示烧完资金之前的时间

words.definition: 苏豪区（纽约曼哈顿的街区）；SOHO（居家办公）
words.definition_en: a district in southwestern Manhattan noted for its shops and restaurants and galleries and artist's lofts · a city district of central London now noted for restaurants and nightclubs

examples.en: SoHo is a great place to see modern art.
examples.zh: 苏豪区是欣赏现代艺术的好地方。

examples.en: I set up a SOHO office in my spare room.
examples.zh: 我在空房间布置了一个居家办公室。

examples.en: Many freelancers start with a SOHO business.
examples.zh: 许多自由职业者从居家办公生意做起。

contexts.sentence: SoHo → Tribeca → Chelsea → High Line → Hudson Yards
contexts.meaning: 指纽约曼哈顿的一个街区，是游览路线中的起点
